questions.question: The Kaveri river basin falls in how many states of India?
questions.solution:
__
 
• The Kaveri river basin falls in how **3 states and a union territory**__ of India.
 
• It falls in Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, and Kerala.
 
• It originates in the foothills of Western Ghats at Talakaveri.
 
• Shimshal, the Hemavati, the Arkavati, Kabini, Bhavani River, Lokapavani, the Noyyal, and the Amaravati River. are some of the tributaries of the Kaveri river.

questions.question: Who appoints Judges of Supreme Court and High Court in India?
questions.solution:
__
 
• **President**__ appoints Judges of Supreme Court and High Court in India.
 
• **Article 124** gives the power to the President.
 
• Judges of the Supreme Court and the High Court can also be removed by the President.
 
• President comes under Articles 52 to 74.
 
• Currently, there are 33+1 judges in SC including CJI.

questions.question: At which temperature are Fahrenheit and Celsius equal?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**-40.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• At **- 40** Fahrenheit and Celsius are equal.
 
• The** Triple point** is the state at which **all three states of matter co-exist**.
 
• The triple point of water is** 273.16 K.**
 
• The normal temperature of a human body is **37°C or 98.6 °F.**

 

Concept__:

__
 
• Temperature: It is the measure of the degree of hotness and coldness of a body.
 
• The SI unit of temperature is Kelvin (K).

Fahrenheit and Celsius are measurements of temperature and are related to each other as follows:

C = (F - 32) × (5)/(9)

Where C is the temperature in Celsius and F is the temperature in Fahrenheit.

EXPLANATION__:

Since we need temperature in fahrenheit and celsius to be equal:

Now, let C = F = x

So,

x = (x - 32) × (5)/(9)

or, 9x = 5x – 160

or, 4x = -160

or, x = -40

Therefore, -40°C = -40°F

questions.solution:

• Nilgiri Hills are also known as the Blue mountains.
 
• Western ghats are divided into two parts namely- Konkan coast and the Malabar coast.

questions.question: What is the reason behind food chains generally having 3-4 Trophic Levels?

options.text: Increasing Number of Organism at each level

questions.solution:
__
 
• **Decreasing Energy at each level**__ is the reason behind food chains generally having 3-4 Trophic Levels.
 
• Only ten percent of the energy is passed on at each trophic level.
 
• Plants, algae, and phytoplankton are the primary producers at grassland biome, pond biome, and ocean biomes respectively.
 
• Apex predators lie at level 4 or 5 at the trophic level.

questions.question: The President of India has same powers and functions as ______.
questions.solution:
__
 
• **The President of India has the same powers and functions as Queen of Britain.**__
 
• They occupy the De jure position in the government. They are the Nominal Head of the state and all decisions and actions are taken in their name.
 
• This is because India has borrowed the Parliamentary government feature from Britain.
 
• Rule of Law, Legislative procedure and Single citizenship are also some borrowed features from Britain.

questions.question: The difference between the value of exports and the value of imports of goods in a country in a given period of time is known as ________.
questions.solution:
__
 
• The **Balance of Payments**__ is the difference between the value of exports and the value of imports of goods trade done by a country over a period of time.
 
• Balance of Trade** **is the difference between the value of exports and the value of imports of goods trade done by a company or corporation.
 
• A trade deficit occurs when the import is greater than export. Developing countries are expected to keep a trade surplus and developed nations are expected to keep a trade deficit.
 
• It is used by economists to measure the relative strength of the Economy.

questions.question: ________ carries oxygenated blood from lungs to heart.
questions.solution:
__
 
• The **Pulmonary Vein**__ carries oxygenated blood from the lungs to the heart.
 
• The **pulmonary artery** carries **deoxygenated blood from the heart to the lungs.**
 
• Veins carry blood towards the heart.
 
• Arteries carry blood away from the heart.
 
• *__**Trick to remember**__- Arteries goes....Veins Come.*

questions.question: Who among the following does NOT take part in the election of the President of India?
questions.solution:
• **Nominated Members of the Parliament** do not take part in the election of the President of India.

• He must have completed the age of 35 years to contest for Presidential elections. He must be a citizen of India.
 
• Article 55 provides for the election of the President.

questions.question: Black Soil is NOT found in which State of India?
questions.solution:
__
 
• **Black soil is found in the Deccan traps region.**__
 
• Sandy loam to clayey soil is found in Punjab.
 
• It is ideal for growing cotton. It is also known as regur soils.

 
 

 
 
Alluvial soils

 
 
 
 
• It a fine-grained fertile soil deposited by water flowing over flood plains or in river beds.
 
• Nitrogen is generally low, but potash, phosphoric acid, and alkalis are adequate.
 
 
 
 

 
 
Black soils

 
 
 
 
• The black soil in India is rich in metals such as Iron, Magnesium, and Aluminium.
 
• It is deficient in Nitrogen, Potassium, Phosphorous, and Humus.
 
• Black soil is of black color mainly due to its iron oxide content.
 
 
 
 

 
 
Laterite soils

 
 
 
 
• Laterite is a soil and rock type rich in iron and aluminum and is commonly considered to have formed in hot and wet tropical areas.
 
• Nearly all laterites are of rusty-red coloration, because of high iron oxide content.
 
• Laterite soils are rich in iron and aluminum but deficient in nitrogen and potassium.

questions.question: Which of the following relations is true?

options.text: GNP ≡ GDP / Net factor income from abroad
GNP ≡ GDP + Net factor income from abroad
GNP ≡ GDP ̶ Net factor income from abroad
GNP ≡ GDP × Net factor income from abroad

questions.solution:
__
 
• Gross National Product is the sum of the Gross Domestic Product and net factor income from abroad.
 
• **GNP ≡ GDP + Net factor income from abroad.**__
 
• Gross Domestic Product is the measure of all finished goods and services made within a country during a specific period.
 
• Net National Product is computed by deducting depreciation from the gross national product.
 
• NNP = GNP – Depreciation
 
• Gross national product(GNP) is the net amount of all the goods and services produced in a country in a given year(GDP) along with the income from abroad.
 
• GNP= GDP + Income from Abroad
